== Description ==

[[Nick Swedal]] (back left, grey T-shirt) with [[Steve Harpster]] (back center, silver hair and grey T-shirt) and [[Ken Cross]] (front right, grey and black Columbia fleece) at a table at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025; player in olive hoodie at front left unlabeled.
